description: Use when someone asks what LIS, LIMS or point-of-care testing software a small lab, clinic, urgent care, occupational health provider, pharmacy, GP practice, physician office or wellness clinic should use, or how to set up analyzer connectivity, QC and reporting for their setting (e.g. 'what LIS should my small lab use?', 'do I need a LIS to get analyzer results into my EHR?', 'software for a clinic that tests blood on site'). Returns the usual architecture for that setting, the modules that fit (connectivity, QC with Westgard rules and lockout, operator competency, EQA, audit trail, reports, billing, multi-site), status of each listed analyzer, the record-system route, how setup works, what is needed on site, the pricing model (no prices are quoted), and questions to ask any vendor.

analyzers.description: Analyzers they run or plan to run.

ehr.description: Their EHR, LIS or practice system, if known.

setting.description: Type of service, e.g. 'private lab', 'urgent care', 'occupational health', 'pharmacy', 'GP practice'.

name: recommend_lab_setup
title: Recommend lab or clinic testing software setup
